get_facebook_statistics.description: Get a Facebook page's statistics from Social Blade: likes, people talking about it, its Social Blade rank and grade, recent growth, and a day-by-day history. Uses Social Blade credits.
get_facebook_statistics.name: get_facebook_statistics

parameters.description: The page's username, such as netflix, as on its Social Blade page.
parameters.name: creator

parameters.description: How many days of history to include. Longer histories cost more Social Blade credits. Leave empty for the last 30 days.
parameters.name: history

options.label: Extended: a longer history, costs more credits
Archive: longer still, costs more credits
Vault: all the history Social Blade has, costs the most credits

daily.description: One row per day, oldest first

talking_about.description: People talking about the page that day

daily_count.description: How many days of history came back

gained_last_30_days.description: Likes gained in the last 30 days

gained_last_7_days.description: Likes gained in the last 7 days

grade.description: Its Social Blade grade, such as A+

grade_color.description: The colour Social Blade shows the grade in

growth.description: Growth over the last 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180 and 365 days, for each figure Social Blade tracks

ranks.description: Where the page ranks on Social Blade for each figure (1 is the highest)

sb_rank.description: Its overall Social Blade rank (1 is the highest)

sb_verified.description: True if Social Blade has verified it

description: Track creators on YouTube, Twitch, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook with Social Blade: their followers, views, rank, grade and daily growth, the platforms' top lists, and workflows that run when a creator reaches a milestone or has a big day.

social_blade_big_day_trigger.description: Runs when a creator's subscribers, page likes or followers change by at least the amount you choose from one day to the next, as Social Blade's daily history shows. Each check uses Social Blade credits.

output.audience: Their subscribers, page likes or followers now
output.audience_name: What the audience figure counts: subscribers, likes or followers
output.change: How much the audience changed that day (negative for a loss)
output.date: The day of the change, YYYY-MM-DD
output.grade: Their Social Blade grade, such as A+
output.id: The creator's ID on the platform

parameters.description: YouTube, Twitch, Instagram, TikTok or Facebook. Leave blank for YouTube.
parameters.name: platform

parameters.description: The channel, account or page to watch: its username, handle or ID, as on its Social Blade page.
parameters.name: creator

parameters.description: The change in one day to watch for, such as 10000.
parameters.name: amount

parameters.description: Gains, losses, or either. Leave blank for gains.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: How often to ask Social Blade. Each check uses Social Blade credits. Leave blank for every 6 hours.
parameters.name: check_every

social_blade_milestone_reached_trigger.description: Runs once when a creator's subscribers (YouTube), page likes (Facebook) or followers reach the number you choose. A creator already past it when the workflow is turned on doesn't start it. Each check uses Social Blade credits.

output.audience: Their subscribers, page likes or followers now
output.audience_name: What the audience figure counts: subscribers, likes or followers
output.grade: Their Social Blade grade, such as A+
output.id: The creator's ID on the platform

parameters.description: YouTube, Twitch, Instagram, TikTok or Facebook. Leave blank for YouTube.
parameters.name: platform

parameters.description: The channel, account or page to watch: its username, handle or ID, as on its Social Blade page.
parameters.name: creator

parameters.description: The number to watch for, such as 1000000.
parameters.name: milestone

parameters.description: How often to ask Social Blade. Each check uses Social Blade credits. Leave blank for every 6 hours.
parameters.name: check_every

social_blade_new_day_trigger.description: Runs when Social Blade adds a day to a creator's daily history, usually once a day, with that day's figures. Each check uses Social Blade credits.

output.audience: Their subscribers, page likes or followers now
output.audience_name: What the audience figure counts: subscribers, likes or followers
output.day: Every figure Social Blade has for that day
output.grade: Their Social Blade grade, such as A+
output.id: The creator's ID on the platform

parameters.description: YouTube, Twitch, Instagram, TikTok or Facebook. Leave blank for YouTube.
parameters.name: platform

parameters.description: The channel, account or page to watch: its username, handle or ID, as on its Social Blade page.
parameters.name: creator

parameters.description: How often to ask Social Blade. Each check uses Social Blade credits. Leave blank for every 6 hours.
